result.title: APEX: Asynchronous Prefix Denoising for Extreme Compression
result.summary: Fewer latent tokens promise cheaper diffusion. Yet aggressive latent compression creates a reconstruction-generation dilemma: adding channels improves reconstruction but makes generation harder. We introduce APEX, short for Asynchronous Prefix denoising for EXtreme compression, which pairs a hierarchical latent space with asynchronous denoising over channel groups. Our autoencoder orders channel prefixes from structure to detail, while one shared denoiser generates them at staggered local times without adding tokens. On ImageNet-512, APEX outperforms existing methods at every evaluated channel count under 64x and 128x compression. At matched training and guided sampling compute, it also outperforms a 256-token model at every evaluated budget, with larger gains at lower compute. Code is available at https://daviddinkevich.github.io/APEX.

AI.brief_summary: APEX 面向极端潜空间压缩的图像扩散生成：用通道前缀从结构到细节排序的层次化潜空间，配合同一 denoiser 对不同通道组按错开局部时间异步去噪，不增加 token，在 ImageNet-512 上于 64x/128x 压缩下优于现有方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「结构到细节」的通道前缀潜表示与分组异步去噪，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节的层次化保留和按计算预算渐进更新 latent 状态提供方法线索，但属图像生成领域，能否迁移到多模态推理尚需核查。
